newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks remain silent.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks remain silent.

text.p: Stocks were very quiet in after-hours trading on the day before Christmas Eve with no noteworthy operations to report, traders said Monday.
"There hasn't been a whole at all," said one trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 149,900 shares, while session two had a larger 3,177,600.
On Friday, session one had 82,000 shares and session two 4,172,003.
